'''"SmartTranq"''' was a type of synthetic [[Tranquilizer dart/Legends|tranquilizer]] produced by the company [[Field Sports]], in cooperation with the [[Corellian Chemical Corporation/Legends|Corellian Chemical Corporation]], for use in Field Sports' [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]], the [[Model 77 air rifle]]. The chemical contained an active ingredient, which when introduced to a target's [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]], began to mutate and adapt constantly. The mutation ensured optimal effectiveness in overcoming targets' immune systems and rendering them unconscious whatever their [[Species/Legends|species]]. "SmartTranq" was available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and could be added to replace the standard tranquilizer found in the [[Dart/Legends|dart]] ammunition of the Model 77 [[air rifle]] for 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The "SmartTranq" was mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Andrew Fischer]] and released in [[2013]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game.<ref name="ETU" />
